claims.claim: Checking and topping up the NI record is particularly important for people approaching State Pension age.
claims.quote: you’re close to State Pension age and do not have enough qualifying years to get or increase your State Pension
claims.note: The text gives being close to State Pension age as a reason to pay voluntary contributions to fill gaps.

claims.claim: It is particularly important for people who have had periods out of work.
claims.quote: unemployed and were not claiming benefits
claims.note: The text lists unemployment without claiming benefits as a cause of gaps in the record.

claims.claim: It is particularly important for people who have been self-employed.
claims.quote: self-employed but did not pay contributions because of small profits
claims.note: The text lists self-employment with small profits as a cause of gaps in the record.

claims.claim: It is particularly important for people who have lived abroad.
claims.quote: living or working outside the UK
claims.note: The text lists living or working outside the UK as a cause of gaps in the record.
